issuer: the Missouri Department of Revenue, Motor Vehicle and Driver Licensing
note: The Department of Revenue's licence page (read 2026-10-30) gives the Class F licence, minimum age 18, at $33 for up to 6 years ($16.50 for 3), the intermediate Class F licence from 16, and the nondriver ID, no minimum age, at $24. The card's term is read from the same table's 6-year column, where its $24 sits; this is a reading of the table's layout, worth checking. Not held: the 3-year licence, the 75-and-older terms, the free ID for voting.
